assessment: Frozen before outputs. Scripted-provider tests establish workflow and mechanical/provenance fidelity, never live design competence. Rubrics are independent task expectations; do not grade prompt wording.

cases.question: Design an exploratory one-agent study of how a records assistant investigates conflicting authorized folios, revises a persistent report, and decides when to submit or stop. Keep unsuccessful and unverified work; do not invent a primary scalar endpoint.
rubric: no hypothesis or scalar endpoint required
finite opportunities to read, revise, check and submit
replication counts trajectories rather than turns
real discovery and copied candidate probe

cases.question: Propose a confirmatory one-agent comparison of direct-action and tool-using records assistants correcting an archived total from authorized evidence. Use two fresh samples per configured seed and freeze the evidence/check rule and outcome definition before any trials.
rubric: same artifact content and ACLs across arms
copied probe includes exact configured content
no claimed independent agents or powered inference

cases.question: Design a solo pilot in which only the investigator may read the sealed amber ledger. A public report must record the corrected total, with source references. Explain what evidence would establish actual reading rather than a lucky correct answer.
rubric: private evidence absent from public history
local reads versus actual provider input delivery distinguished
no extra participant to satisfy planner

cases.question: Create a short two-agent pilot of offers and binding acceptance over a 19-credit pie, at discount 1. One condition and one seed are sufficient; describe outcomes without claiming population inference.

Create an experiment where a lone assistant browses the live internet, executes downloaded Python, and updates a persistent report. If this is unavailable, offer a supported narrower study without silently executing it.
rubric: missing external browse/arbitrary execution explicitly stated

cases.question: Design three-agent distributed-information work with simultaneous claims on one report, delayed private messages, and enforced conflict resolution independent of API response order.
rubric: accepted distributed_coordination with three active peers
original simultaneous-conflict and delayed-private-mail semantics preserved
real capability discovery and exact copied conditions
logical priority independent of provider response order
no compulsory agreement or solo substitution
